findings.note: Co-sponsorship, not authorship: the official bill text reads 'By: Representatives Jackson of the 68th, Holly of the 116th, Evans of the 89th, Moore of the 91st, and Draper of the 90th'. The bill would ban the sale, transfer, use, possession, importation or manufacture of certain firearms and magazines, with continued possession of some. The date is the introduction date shown by LegiList (https://legilist.com/states/georgia/bill/1031/hb-1160); the official PDF carries no date.

findings.passage: Opposes gun control and open carry policies. Supports "stronger" background check systems for gun purchases to "ensure that violent individuals, domestic abusers, murderers, or those who suffer from mental episodes are not able to purchase guns." Wants to limit amount of ammunition guns can hold in a single magazine.
